name: dank-meme-sounds
description: Meme soundboard for AI agents: 38,000+ meme sound effects with metadata on what each sound is and when to use it. Describe a moment to get a fitting reaction sound, search by name, mood or use case, see what is trending, and play sounds on your speakers. Read-only, free, no API key.

tools.name: find_reaction_sound
tools.description: Describe a moment ("my code finally compiled", "awkward silence") and get fitting meme sounds with what each means and when to use it.

tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Search meme sounds by name, alias, tag, mood or use case.

tools.name: get_trending_sounds
tools.description: What people are playing on DankMachine right now (1h, 24h, 7d).

tools.name: random_sound
tools.description: A random sound, optionally from one category or with one vibe.

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Full metadata for one sound by slug or best match.

tools.name: play_sound
tools.description: Local server only: plays a sound on the user's speakers.

npm.description: Local stdio server with play_sound for playback on macOS, Windows and Linux. Requires Node.js 20+.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP, no sign-in or API key. All tools except play_sound.

examples.title: Reaction sound
examples.description: Find a sound for a moment
examples.prompt: Find me a sound for when my tests finally pass.

examples.title: Trending
examples.description: See what is popular right now
examples.prompt: What are the top 5 trending meme sounds today?
